summary: Hybrid IdP SAML NameQualifier change causes tenant-scoped service-account bindings to be rejected (403) in private deployment
summary_long: After the customer's IdP changed SAML NameQualifier values during a maintenance rollout, CloudLedger's service account assertions no longer map to the expected tenant identity in our private deployment, resulting in consistent 403s for admin/service operations.
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports 403 responses for admin API calls and service account flows shortly after their IdP (on-prem ADFS + cloud proxy) pushed a configuration change that normalizes NameID/NameQualifier values. Impact:
- Admin console access is blocked for service workflows (automated backups, key rotations).
- Several scheduled jobs fail and trigger downstream errors in the customer's product.
Environment:
- Private deployment (VPC) with tenant-scoped RBAC and ingress path rewrite enabled.
- Requests flow through customer-managed IdP proxy -> Edge ingress -> private control plane.
Expected behavior:
- SAML assertions from the IdP map to tenant-scoped service-account identities and are accepted.
Actual behavior:
- SAML assertion subject contains NameID and a NameQualifier that does not match the tenant prefix in our tenant resolution logic; our auth layer rejects the assertion as unmapped, returning 403.
Notes: this started immediately after the IdP maintenance window and affects all service accounts that rely on SAML subject mapping.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer triggers a service account token exchange via SAML assertion (SAML response generated by IdP with new NameQualifier).
2) Request traverses customer IdP proxy -> edge ingress; ingress rewrites path and forwards assertion to private control plane auth endpoint.
3) Auth layer attempts tenant resolution by concatenating tenant prefix + NameQualifier -> fails mapping lookup -> returns 403.
4) Reverting IdP to previous NameQualifier restores normal mapping and clears 403s (reported by customer).
logs:
Excerpt from private control plane auth logs (sanitized):
[2026-03-11T09:12:04Z] auth.evaluated_assertion tenant_lookup="tenant-prefix:acme-corp" expected_namequal="https://idp.acme.com/tn1" actual_namequal="https://idp.acme.com/tn1-v2" result=NOT_FOUND status=403 request_id=req_0a7f
investigation_notes: 03/11 10:00 - Support triage: reproduced 403 in staging by rewriting NameQualifier on test SAML response; tenant resolution routine does strict equality match (prefix + NameQualifier) and fails.
03/11 13:35 - Confirmed customer IdP maintenance changed NameQualifier semantics; they applied a namespacing update to multi-tenant proxy (adds -v2 suffix for proxy routing).
03/12 08:20 - Ingress team validated that path rewrite is not stripping NameQualifier but does perform header normalization; nothing dropped in transit.
03/12 14:50 - Hypothesis: tenant resolution should tolerate NameQualifier suffix changes (semantic namespace variations) or consult IdP metadata alias list.
comments: Dana Koh (Support): Customer reports immediate failure after IdP maintenance; provided SAML response and timestamps. Asked customer to share IdP metadata and recent change logs.

Customer (CloudLedger): Confirmed change history: added namespacing to NameQualifier to support routed IdP proxies. They can rollback but prefer a platform-side tolerant mapping to avoid future disruptions.
Marcus Chen (Auth Eng): Reproduced locally; strict matching in tenant resolver is intentional for safety. Propose short-term workaround and long-term fix. Assigned to auth team for patching.
SRE (Ingress): Verified request body unchanged, base64 SAML response reaches auth endpoint. No TLS or proxy errors observed.
hypothesis: Tenant resolver currently performs strict concatenation of tenant prefix and NameQualifier. IdP introduced a variant NameQualifier (suffix -v2) for proxy routing. Resolver should consult IdP metadata aliases or perform normalized prefix match when mapping service-account NameID to tenant; otherwise legitimate assertions are rejected.
mitigation_steps: 1) Ask customer to rollback NameQualifier change in IdP while we prepare patch (fastest immediate mitigation).
2) Temporary allowlist: add explicit mapping for NameQualifier variants in tenant metadata (requires customer-provided list).
3) Implement tolerant matching in tenant resolver (see long-term fix).
resolution:
Workaround applied: customer rolled back NameQualifier change during support window which restored service workflows (confirmed 2026-03-12 02:17 UTC). Auth engineering implemented a short-lived configuration option to map the new NameQualifier variant to the existing tenant mapping (deployed to private customer control plane 2026-03-13).
Long-term: auth team will implement alias-aware tenant resolution (RFC created, PR link below) that reads IdP metadata aliases and supports controlled suffix normalization. Follow-up action: schedule patch for private deployments and add automated test coverage for NameQualifier variants.
